newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Advance meets about St George merger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Advance meets about St George merger.

text.p: Advance Bank Australia Ltd shareholders began meeting in Sydney this morning to consider the regional bank's plan to merge with Sydney rival St George Bank Ltd.

About 600 shareholders had gathered at the Entertainment Centre to discuss and then vote on the A$2.65 billion takeover proposal which involves a mixture of shares and cash. The bid values Advance at A$2.65 billion, or about A$7.30 per share.
Specifically, Advance shareholders will be asked at the end of the meeting to vote on a scheme of arrangement proposal which will allow the takeover to proceed.
One aspect of the proposal, which rules that abstaining shares will be deemed to be in favour of the takeover, has been queried by the Australian Securities Commission (ASC).
In effect, 75 percent support at the meeting will be deemed to equate to complete support for the proposal.

Advance said last Friday it had been told by the ASC that the regulator would not interfere in Monday's meeting but would appear at a court hearing on January 6 where the scheme of arrangement proposal must also be approved.
Recent media reports said giant Melbourne-based National Australia Bank Ltd had encouraged the ASC query.
